transcript.answer: I have worked for two main employers. I started at Example Rail Services as a Software Developer from 2015 to 2017. Currently, since 2023, I have been working as a Consultant for Example Consulting on projects for the client Example Water Utility.

transcript.question: At Example Rail Services, what did you do as a Software Developer? What projects worked on and what tasks did you complete?
transcript.answer: I wrote the import job that loads timetable files into the planning database. I also cut the nightly timetable import from 3 hours down to 40 minutes. Additionally, I moved the planning database to a new server along with the rest of the development team.

transcript.question: At Example Clinics Group, what did you do as a Backend Developer? What projects worked on and what tasks did you complete?

transcript.question: As a Technical Lead at Example Clinics Group, what did you do? What projects worked on and what tasks did you complete?

I built an AI assistant that writes our release notes using prompt templates. I also set up the monitoring: logs, dashboards and tracing.
